synŏdĭcus , a, um, adj., = συνοδικός,
I.going or coming together, synodical: luna, i. e. when in conjunction with the sun, Firm. Math. 3, 6; 4 praef. fin.—
II. According to the decrees of the synod, Cassiod. Hist. Eccl. 4, 21; 9, 13.—Hence, adv.: synŏdĭcē , in accordance with the synod's decrees, Cassiod. Hist. Eccl. 4, 25.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
